snippet.title: HELLSLAVE II - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
The Archon has descended. The purge begins. 🔥 HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon 🔥is coming on Steam! 👉 Wishlist now: https://hellslavegame.com From the creator of HellSlave, this sequel delivers deeper lore, richer combat, and even more twisted choices! Destroy the demon lords or perish with the world in this new brutal dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG. 🎁 From June 2 to 16, COLLECT HellSlave for FREE and keep it forever!

😈 What is HellSlave II about? 😈
HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler where you must destroy the demon lords before the heavens wipe the world clean. Customize your character, master the brutal turn-based combat, and explore a doomed world between damnation and divine wrath. This sequel takes everything fans loved: gritty lore, comic book-style hand-drawn art, and tactical combat that raises the bar to hell.

HellSlave II is developed by Ars Goetia Games and published by Dear Villagers
